dedupe_keys.name: data integration of urban surface and river bathymetry to support flood risk management

description: Data integration of urban surface and river bathymetry to support flood risk management is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Álvaro Esteban-Muñoz et al. Urban flood modelling demands detailed terrain and bathymetry data. However, elevation models often omit street-level geometry, urban infrastructure, and river bathymetry. Here we present a high-resolution integrated urban surface–river bathymetry dataset for the Duero River (Spain). Its novelty lies in coupling surveyed river-channel bathymetry with sub-metre urban geometry. Coverage: national (ES); published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The paper's page was read, but no repository address could be taken from its machine-readable metadata, so the record links to the article, whose Data Records section names where the data sit. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
